findings_verbatim.title: Candidate does not enforce original probability integrity contract
findings_verbatim.impact: Zero-norm and norm-four states return ordinary metrics. Finite 1e308 amplitudes overflow to inf/nan without rejection. Original range/sum guard rejects these. Constants stay 1e-12, but enforcement is removed: accepted scientific domain differs.
findings_verbatim.remediation: In a separately authorized source change, enforce original absolute 1e-12 range/sum and finite-result contract; add failing zero-norm, scaled-norm and overflow tests. Do not renormalize or relax tolerance.

findings_verbatim.title: Recorded run commits do not reconstruct the scientific execution entrypoint
findings_verbatim.impact: rank01 runner is absent at its recorded commit and has no execution-time source SHA. rank02/03 recorded ff1d579 has the helper SHA but qaoa.run_single has no implementation argument and runner is absent. Wiring and runner first appear at 0e149ed, after run completion. Current helper differs again at d4a8d78. A helper hash alone cannot certify executed bytes; no inference of fabrication is made.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Recover contemporaneous runner, qaoa and dependency snapshots or logs with hashes and start-time dirty diff; explicitly qualify historical results if recovery is impossible. Preserve existing results and identify any future reproduction as new evidence.

findings_verbatim.title: Existing equivalence acceptance is not computed from assertions and does not exercise the shipped helper
findings_verbatim.impact: Report generator writes PASS/all_gates_pass=True independently of numerical differences. Harness reimplements candidate arithmetic instead of calling indexed_probability_metrics; small_full_method flag does not execute full enumeration; best_feasible_route maximizes probability rather than minimizing route cost. New probes substantiate normalized-domain equivalence but do not validate historical acceptance generation.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Use actual candidate and original functions with an independent reference; derive every gate from measured assertions; mutation-test failing gates; make labels reflect actual coverage and best-route semantics.

findings_verbatim.title: Current canonical status asserts unsupported convergence 3/3
findings_verbatim.impact: rank01 optimizer_success=false and OBJECTIVE_EVALUATION_CAP_REACHED at 300 contradict convergence 3/3. Other summary data retain the unfavorable result. rank02/03 only report native optimizer success; no global convergence is established.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Correct status claim to exact route recovery 3/3; rank01 cap reached, native optimizer reported success 2/3; retain low raw probabilities and uncertainty. This audit leaves status documents unchanged.

findings_verbatim.title: Runtime and memory comparisons lack matched workloads and complete execution conditions
findings_verbatim.impact: 33.70x uses full rank01 run/nfev versus prototype single evaluation. Timed v2 region omits simulation, index construction, actual guards and route reporting. ru_maxrss absolute peak, peak increments and approximate observed RSS are different metrics. rank02/03 reported peaks 0.309/0.278 GiB are below a fully touched complex128 25q state (0.5 GiB), requiring provenance/process-boundary reconciliation.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Retain PRELIMINARY_ONLY; measure matched source versions, parameters, timer and process boundaries with all thread settings and all repetitions, including setup/final reporting. Use identical absolute peak metrics; do not claim a formal reduction factor.

findings_verbatim.title: V4 drops reported scientific diagnostics under unchanged result schema
findings_verbatim.impact: energy_variance becomes None; most_probable_state, most_probable_feasible_state, records and tolerance metadata are absent. Reduced compact route/probability results can agree, but complete run_single result equivalence is false. Threshold and route-cost tie order are preserved in current adapter.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Document a versioned compact output contract and missing diagnostics; restore required diagnostics in a separately reviewed implementation if consumers require them. Do not advertise full output equivalence.

findings_verbatim.title: Numerical dtype contract accepts lower precision inputs
findings_verbatim.impact: dtype.kind accepts complex64/float32; vdot and optimal dot retain input precision. No implicit downcast occurs for governed complex128 Aer states, but the public helper does not enforce that scientific precision contract.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Specify and enforce supported precision, then test error bounds with complex64/float32 and overflow. Preserve complex128/float64 production behavior and 1e-12 tolerance.

findings_verbatim.title: Historical immutability and optimizer replay evidence are incomplete
findings_verbatim.impact: rank01 raw files are ignored/untracked. Current compact records omit final parameters, objective trace and explicit configured cap/options. Tracked rank02/03 records are unchanged since addition, but exact historical execution/replay cannot be established by the retained data.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Archive immutable raw snapshots and execution-time hashes outside any existing output namespace; retain full compact optimizer trace/parameters/config in future runs. Record historical gaps explicitly rather than reconstructing unobserved facts.

findings_verbatim.title: Penalty authority contains inconsistent margin arithmetic
findings_verbatim.impact: lambda=4 and bound=3 are correct, but lambda_minus_bound=0.5 and penalty_energy_margin=1.0 are inconsistent with 4-3=1 and 2*4-6=2. The sufficient inequality remains valid.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Issue an authority erratum for derived margin fields while keeping lambda=4.0 and the scientific definition fixed.

findings_verbatim.title: Benchmark P_optimal_lookup is an arbitrary feasible index proxy
findings_verbatim.impact: The timed benchmark uses idx[-1:] rather than the exact optimum set. It reports 8.817886471048181e-7 where actual rank01 initial P_optimal is 8.911426703519106e-7. This is not leakage into the optimizer or production helper, but benchmark output must not be used as scientific P_optimal.
findings_verbatim.remediation: Label the existing value as an arbitrary feasible lookup proxy; benchmark the actual candidate reporting function with the authoritative optimum set and account for lookup setup.
